WITH env_site_join AS (
  SELECT 
    se.imgcount,
    s.phasefactor
  FROM scanenvironment se
  INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
phase_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    phasefactor,
    SUM(imgcount) as phase_total
  FROM env_site_join
  GROUP BY phasefactor
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(phase_total) as total
  FROM phase_totals
),
phase_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.phase_total,
    CAST(pt.phase_total AS FLOAT) / ot.total as share
  FROM phase_totals pt
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
  WHERE ot.total IS NOT NULL
),
average_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM phase_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.phase_total,
    ps.share - asv.avg_share as share_diff
  FROM phase_shares ps
  CROSS JOIN average_share_value asv
  WHERE asv.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND ps.share > asv.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(phase_total) as total_phase_totals,
  (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value) as average_share,
  AVG(share_diff) as average_share_difference
FROM filtered
